methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series G → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.25x) to $75M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Earth AI, founded by Roman Teslyuk, is a Series G infrastructure and logistics company that has raised $20M to date. The valuation analysis is constrained by the absence of public comparables and identified private peers in the infrastructure and logistics sector, limiting the breadth of triangulation available.

The stage-progression method is the applicable approach given data availability. Using total capital raised ($20M) as a proxy for enterprise value baseline and scaling to $75M, a Series G to next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.25x yields an implied valuation of $94M. This method reflects typical venture progression economics at the growth stage but relies on the assumption that total raised correlates meaningfully to current value creation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $80M (low) to $108M (median $94M), with Earth AI positioned at the median. Key uncertainties include the lack of sector-specific comparables to validate whether the 1.25x multiplier appropriately reflects infrastructure and logistics company dynamics, and reliance on a single methodological input. The $20M historical raise provides limited visibility into revenue traction, unit economics, or competitive positioning. Additional data on recurring revenue, customer concentration, and peer valuations in the infrastructure-logistics space would materially improve conviction in this range.
